sn16.5:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kassapaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn16.5:1.4: Jiṇṇo si tvaṃ Kassapa garukāni ca te imāni sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanāni ||
sn16.5:1.5: tasmā ti ha tvaṃ Kassapa gahapatāni ceva cīvarāni dhārehi nimantanāni ca bhuñjāhi mama ca santike viharāhīti || || 4
sn16.5:2.1: Ahaṃ kho bhante dīgharattam araññako ceva araññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī || piṇḍapātiko ceva piṇḍapātikattassa ca vaṇṇavādī || paṃsukūliko ceva paṃsukūlikattassa vaṇṇavādī || tecīvariko ceva tecīvarikattassa ca vaṇṇavādī || appiccho ceva appicchatāya vaṇṇavādī || santuṭṭho ceva santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī || pavivitto ceva pavivekassa ca vaṇṇavādī || asaṃsaṭṭho ceva asaṃsaggassa ca vaṇṇavādī || āraddhaviriyo ceva viriyārambhassa ca vaṇṇavādīti || 5
sn16.5:3.1: Kimpana tvaṃ Kassapa atthavasaṃ sampassamāno dīgharattaṃ araññako ceva araññakattassa vaṇṇavādi || || Evam peyyālo || || piṇḍapātiko ceva ||
sn16.5:4.1: Dve kvāham bhante atthavase sampassamāno dīgharattam araññako ceva araññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī || pe|| || piṇḍapātiko ceva ||
sn16.5:5.1: Attano ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno pacchimaṃ ca janatam anukampamāno
sn16.5:5.3: Ye kira te ahesuṃ buddhānubuddhasāvakā te dīgharattaṃ araññakā ceva ahesuṃ araññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādino || pe||
sn16.5:5.11: āraddhaviriyā ceva ahesuṃ || viriyārambhassa ca vaṇṇavādino ti ||
sn16.5:5.12: te tathattāya paṭipajjissanti || tesaṃ tam bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya || || 8
sn16.5:6.1: Ime khvāham bhante dve atthavase sampassamāno dīgharattam araññako ceva araññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī || piṇḍapātiko ceva ||
sn16.5:7.2: bahujanahitāya kira tvaṃ Kassapa paṭipanno bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ || || 10
sn16.5:7.3: Tasmātiha tvaṃ Kassapa sāṇāni ceva paṃsukūlikāni dhārehi nibbasanāni || piṇḍapatāya ca carāhi araññe ca viharāhīti || ||
